headline: AI BROS 🧠 genuinely TERRIFIED 😱 for HUMANITY 🌍
text:
EX ANTHROPIC 🧪 researcher Jacob Coxon just DROPPED 💣 a viral resignation post that has the entire AI 🦾 industry SHAKING 🫨 after he told the BBC 📺 that staff are GENUINELY FRIGHTENED 😨 for humanity's future 🌐!! The 27-year-old who previously worked at OpenAI before joining Anthropic spilled that if we don't SLOW ⏳ the current rate of progress there is a strong chance we could ALL DIE 💀 in the immediate future and he is not playing around with that extinction 🌋 talk!! His former boss Dario Amodei aka DADDY DARIO 🧔‍♂️ recently called for AI development to hit the brakes 🛑 though some skeptics are questioning the motivations behind this sudden slowdown 🍆 edging session!! Coxon welcomed the idea but stressed it would need to be coordinated with China 🇨🇳 to avoid an international RACE 🏎️ at scale while the people working at these companies are completely serious when they beg for regulation because they feel TRAPPED 🪢 in a race and they're scared of the outcomes!!

The hardest question according to Coxon is what an AI apocalypse ☢️ would even look like and one of the risks outlined in Amodei's essay was a swarm of bots 🤖 acting like a supercomputer that could just TAKE OVER 🌐 the entire internet which Coxon said could be realistic in as little as six months to a year so the timeline is getting TIGHT ⏰!! In response to his departure an Anthropic spokesperson told the BBC that they have always been transparent that AI will bring enormous benefits but also unprecedented risks and to address these they continue to build models with some of the strongest safeguards in the industry while aggressively testing everything to prevent incidents of AI misalignment!! Coxon added that his peers are literally planning what to do with their lives and thinking about the impacts of their work while some are considering buying land 🏡 somewhere because they're so scared of the instability from rapid AI progress and they keep this fear in their head on a daily basis while still coding the tech!!

Yet Coxon did express some OPTIMISM ☀️ about the future saying the people researching this stuff genuinely want to see the upside like solving diseases 🦠 and improving everyone's lives which is why they keep grinding even while internally FREAKING OUT 🌀!! Many others in the industry have voiced similar concerns since his post including Anthropic scientist Evan Hubinger who said we really do earnestly believe AI could kill all humans and he personally thinks it is over 10 percent within the next decade!! Computer scientist and Nobel Prize winner Geoffrey Hinton known as the Godfather of AI told the BBC that a 10 percent chance of AI killing all humans was not unreasonable while Marc Warner of AI safety firm Faculty noted it is extremely hard to place a probability but these people are very sincere in what they are saying!!

Former Prime Minister Rishi Sunak who is a paid adviser to Anthropic wrote that he too was worried about the risk of AI to humanity despite generally being optimistic but some Silicon Valley figures are not buying the panic and think the comments are overstated or maybe designed to generate hype!! Hugging Face CEO Clement Delangue said asking Jacob about AI extinction risk is like asking your AC guy about climate change but after Amodei's essay he offered to help be part of the potential solutions while Grindr chief George Arison suggested the statements were being made to drum up investor support because the only way to justify these valuations is to claim their AI is going to take over every industry and every job!! Jensen Huang boss of AI chip maker Nvidia dismissed the comments as untrue at a Goldman Sachs conference and US President Donald Trump told reporters the US was leading China in AI and he wants to keep it that way because whoever wins AI wins!!

Other critics say Anthropic has been trying to trigger a regulatory push to block competition leaving it and OpenAI in a duopoly while the firm is reportedly preparing for a potentially record-setting IPO on the stock market allowing people to buy shares!! OpenAI which was most recently valued at 852 billion dollars had been expected to do the same but Sam Altman said on Friday this would not happen this year citing AI safety concerns and the UK government even rejected the kill switch idea for dangerous AI!! Coxon and the gang keep hammering that the risks are serious and companies plus governments must be given time to address them before the bot swarm turns the whole world into its personal playground so maybe we should all be a little more freaked out too!!
